T: The saga ends. The snacks don't.
D: Rey and her friends race to find the hidden world where the Emperor has returned.
P: Serve the snacks during the festival on Pasaana.
S: Sumac flatbreads with beet and herb dips
Grilled sumac flatbreads with a pink beet yogurt dip and a green herb dip
Flatbreads brushed with oil and dusted with sumac, paprika and turmeric, grilled and served with three dips: hummus, beetroot and green herb yoghurt.
Steamed ginger chicken dumplings in hot chicken stock with scallion
Chicken and ginger dumplings steamed 10 minutes, served in a little hot broth with spring onion and chilli oil.

Bite-sized toasts piled with a buttery mushroom, thyme and garlic pâté, topped with a sliver of cornichon and crispy shallot. Small enough for Babu Frik. Fry 300g chopped mushrooms in 40g butter with 2 garlic cloves and thyme until dark and dry. Blitz with 80g cream cheese, salt and pepper until smooth and chill. Cut a baguette into 20 thin slices, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes. Fry 2 sliced shallots in oil until crisp. Spread the pâté on the toasts and top with sliced cornichons and crispy shallots.
M: Fish, shrimp and mussels in a saffron fennel tomato broth
Fish, prawns and mussels simmered in a tomato, fennel and white wine broth with saffron, served with garlic toast.
the whole fleet arriving over Exegol

Rib eye seared in a smoking pan and basted in garlic butter, sliced over buttery mash with a punchy cracked peppercorn cream sauce. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Season 4 rib eye steaks and sear in a smoking pan for 3 minutes, flip, add 40g butter and 2 garlic cloves and baste for 3 minutes. Rest. Add 2 tsp crushed black peppercorns to the pan, then 150ml beef stock, 1 tsp Dijon and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Slice the steaks over the mash and pour over the sauce.
W: Meringue topped with whipped cream, sliced mango and two pools of passionfruit
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream, mango and passionfruit for two glowing suns.
K: Cold milk and coconut milk blended with honey and tinted pale blue
Milk blended with coconut milk, honey and a few drops of blue colouring, served cold.

dishes.n: Sumac flatbreads with beet and herb dips
dishes.make_ahead: Dips up to 2 days, grill breads fresh

steps.text: Roast the beetroot at 200C until tender, then cool and peel.
Blend the beetroot with the garlic and some of the yoghurt for a pink dip. Stir the herbs through more yoghurt for a green dip.
Brush the flatbreads with oil, dust with sumac and turmeric and grill until blistered. Serve with the dips and hummus.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 1 day ahead, steam fresh

ingredients.item: spring onions, sliced, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the ginger, spring onion and soy.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Serve a few in each bowl with hot stock, more spring onion and a drizzle of chilli oil.
Soften the fennel and garlic in the oil. Add the saffron, tomatoes and wine.
Add the fish, prawns and mussels, cover and cook until the mussels open.
Toast the bread, rub with a cut garlic clove and serve alongside.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, top just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.
Shape into a round on a lined tray and bake at 120C. Cool in the oven.
Top with whipped cream, mango and two round pools of passionfruit pulp.
Blend the milk, coconut milk, honey and ice until frothy.
Add a few drops of blue colouring and blend until evenly pale blue. Serve cold.

s.n: Sumac flatbreads with beet and herb dips
s.note: Grilled sumac flatbreads with a pink beet yogurt dip and a green herb dip
s.how: Brush flatbreads with olive oil and dust with sumac and a little turmeric, then grill until blistered. Blend roasted beetroot with garlic and a spoon of yoghurt for a pink dip, and stir herbs through more yoghurt for a green dip. Serve with hummus.

s.note: Steamed ginger chicken dumplings in hot chicken stock with scallion
s.how: Mix 400g chicken mince with grated ginger, sliced spring onion and soy. Fill dumpling wrappers, pleat closed and steam for 10 minutes. Serve a few in each bowl with a ladle of hot chicken stock, more spring onion and a drizzle of chilli oil.

m.note: Fish, shrimp and mussels in a saffron fennel tomato broth
m.how: Soften sliced fennel and garlic in olive oil, add a pinch of saffron, a can of crushed tomatoes and a cup of white wine and simmer 20 minutes. Add 400g white fish chunks, 300g green prawns and 500g mussels, cover and cook 6 minutes. Serve with garlic toast.

w.note: Meringue topped with whipped cream, sliced mango and two pools of passionfruit
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream, sliced mango and two round pools of passionfruit pulp.

d.note: Cold milk and coconut milk blended with honey and tinted pale blue
d.how: Blend 750ml cold milk with 250ml coconut milk, 2 tbsp honey and a handful of ice until frothy. Add a few drops of blue food colouring and blend again until evenly pale blue. Pour into glasses and serve cold, the way the moisture farm does.
